reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I have a real reason, and a named independent lab with the batch report behind a QR code is the first time a supplement ad answered my question. With the empty-box refund and the $24.99 launch price, one box is a cheap test.
objection: A lab report on their own page only proves the batch matches the label, not that magnesium does anything for me. I would still want my doctor to confirm my level first.
